title: Nvidia says two mystery customers accounted for 39% of Q2 revenue
summary: Nearly 40% of Nvidia’s second quarter revenue came from just two companies, identified in a filing as "Customer A" and "Customer B."

title: Dollar General Admits It Has Higher Prices, Commits to $1 Items
summary: The discount retailer isn't a better value than Walmart, Target, or your local grocery chain, but it's usually cheaper.
